## Review checklist

- [ ] Success, boundary, and failure behavior are covered.
- [ ] Financial effects remain idempotent and reconcilable.
- [ ] Logs and reports contain no secrets or sensitive data.
- [ ] Requirements and test documentation match the implementation.
- [ ] Rollback or recovery behavior is understood.
